facts.fact: UNDP's January-March 2026 newsletter says officials at the Santa Luzia Civil Registry Office in Bissau record births, marriages and deaths directly on the national platform, SIREC; the newsletter gives no date for this, so its publication month is used.
facts.system: Integrated Citizen Registration and Statistics System (SIREC)

facts.fact: UNDP says the Santa Luzia office has replaced paper registry books with workstations connected to the national platform, records being entered directly, generated in real time and held in a centralised system; undated in the newsletter, so its publication month is used.
facts.system: Integrated Citizen Registration and Statistics System (SIREC)

facts.fact: UNDP says the Santa Luzia Civil Registry Office in Bissau is the first in the country to operate entirely digitally; no total number of offices is given, and the date is the newsletter's publication month.
facts.system: Integrated Citizen Registration and Statistics System (SIREC)

facts.fact: UNDP's newsletter for January-March 2026 reports as a milestone that the Santa Luzia office in Bissau became the first civil registry office in the country to operate entirely digitally on SIREC; the newsletter gives no day, so the last month of the quarter it covers is used.
facts.system: Integrated Citizen Registration and Statistics System (SIREC)

facts.fact: UNDP says SIREC was developed with funding from the European Union and the Camões Institute under the GESTDOC project, and that the digitisation of records is co-financed by the Swiss Confederation and implemented by UNDP; no domestic funding is mentioned, and the date is the newsletter's publication month.
facts.system: Integrated Citizen Registration and Statistics System (SIREC)

systems.system: Integrated Citizen Registration and Statistics System (SIREC)
systems.tiers: described as the national platform; Santa Luzia Civil Registry Office in Bissau named as the first office fully digital; an official of the 3rd Registry Office in Bissau is quoted saying everything is now stored digitally
